title: Azure Data Science Academy
tagline: Design, build, deploy and operate data science and AI systems on Microsoft Azure.
objectives: Navigate Azure's control plane (tenants, subscriptions, resource groups, RBAC) and work securely from WSL, VS Code and Python.
Explain how data lakes, warehouses, lakehouses, medallion layers and data mesh fit together, and map each to concrete Azure services.
Build governed data products on ADLS Gen2, Azure Databricks or Microsoft Fabric, with contracts, quality checks and catalog entries.
Train, track, register and deploy models with Azure Machine Learning and MLflow, then automate them with CI/CD and IaC.
Build production-grade RAG and agentic services with Microsoft Foundry and Azure AI Search.
Operate everything within budget, with identity-based auth, network isolation and observability.
sequence: Start with Module 1 and Lab 01, then Module 3 (the architectural core, runnable locally), then the remaining modules in order. The retail demand forecasting capstone grows a little in every lab.

modules.title: Azure Fundamentals for Data Scientists
modules.description: Tenants, subscriptions, resource groups, regions, Entra ID, RBAC, managed identities, Key Vault, budgets and a secure WSL dev setup.

modules.title: Cloud Storage and Data Access
modules.description: Blob Storage vs ADLS Gen2, hierarchical namespace, ACLs, reading and writing Parquet with pandas/PyArrow/adlfs, Azure SQL Database and access patterns.

modules.title: Data Lakes, Lakehouses and Data Mesh
modules.description: Lake vs warehouse vs lakehouse, medallion layers, Delta Lake and Iceberg, OneLake vs ADLS Gen2, Databricks vs Fabric, data products, contracts and federated governance.

modules.title: Data Pipelines and Scalable Processing
modules.description: Azure Data Factory and Fabric Data Factory, Databricks Jobs, PySpark, incremental ingestion and CDC, data validation and pipeline testing.

modules.title: Azure Machine Learning Fundamentals
modules.description: Workspaces, compute, environments, data assets, components, command jobs, MLflow tracking, sweeps and reproducibility.

modules.title: Model Management and Deployment
modules.description: Model registry and versioning, managed online endpoints, batch endpoints, FastAPI integration, auth, scaling and release criteria.

modules.title: MLOps and Production Operations
modules.description: Training pipelines, GitHub Actions with OIDC, Bicep/Terraform, testing, drift, monitoring, alerting, retraining and lineage.

modules.title: Azure AI and Generative AI
modules.description: Microsoft Foundry (formerly Azure AI Foundry), model deployments, embeddings, Azure AI Search, RAG ingestion, FastAPI AI services, agents, evaluation and cost.

modules.title: Enterprise Architecture, Security and Governance
modules.description: Landing zones, environment separation, private endpoints, Key Vault, Purview classification and lineage, responsible AI, tagging and cost allocation.

modules.title: End-to-End Capstone: Retail Demand Forecasting
modules.description: Local baseline, medallion lakehouse, governed data products, Azure ML training pipeline, batch and online inference, monitoring and cost optimisation.
